purpose: Teach: レター/高性能/撮ら/商用/出所/明細/否め/バージョンアップ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、住民からのお礼レター、励みになります。
lines.en: Thank you letters from residents really do encourage the work we do.
lines.style: Measured, professional warmth. Slight pause before the word 'thank you' lands. Genuine appreciation without overstatement. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。高性能の防犯カメラ、社屋に、設置済みです。
lines.en: Yes. We've already installed high-performance security cameras throughout the building.
lines.style: Clear, cooperative tone. Brisk pacing to show readiness. Matter-of-fact report without defensiveness. Slight nod in the voice on 'installed'.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察活動、撮らないように、お願いする場面、ございます。
lines.en: That said, there are situations where we ask businesses not to record police operations.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Light procedural weight on each phrase. Patient explanation — not lecturing, clarifying protocol. Slight pause before 'operations'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商用施設の防犯、警察と連携、強化しております。
lines.en: Understood. We're actively strengthening our crime prevention measures through coordination with police.
lines.style: Engaged and businesslike. Confident pacing. Shows responsiveness without rushing. Light emphasis on 'coordination' — demonstrates commitment to the partnership.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、出所先、引き続き、追跡しております。
lines.en: We're continuing to track the suspect's movements after release.
lines.style: Factual, steady tone. No urgency — this is ongoing work. Slight weight on 'continuing' to show diligence. Quiet professional confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害明細、警察様に、ご提出済みです。
lines.en: Yes. We've already submitted a full damage report to your department.
lines.style: Brief, efficient. Confirms completion without elaboration. Professional shorthand between two parties who understand the process. Slight nod in tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯活動の重要性、否めないことを、再認識いたしました。
lines.en: This conversation has really reinforced how important crime prevention work is.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pace. Slight warmth under the formality — this isn't just procedural observation. Measured delivery, like a quiet conclusion. Trailing slight pause at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内のセキュリティ、定期、バージョンアップしております。
lines.en: Yes. We maintain regular security updates on all internal systems.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Shows ongoing commitment without over-explaining. Slight closing quality — wrapping up the specific item. Professional and routine.
